prompt:
Users want to duplicate an episode, to try another take without losing the original.
- Add `POST /api/v1/episodes/{id}/duplicate`, returning the new episode. The copy goes after the project's other episodes, its title marks it as a copy, and it keeps the summary and the same cuts in the same order, with their scripts, dialogues, layouts, characters and images. Changing or deleting either episode afterwards never affects the other. Duplicating is free. Only members of the episode's workspace may duplicate it; to anyone else the episode does not exist (404).
- On the project's Episodes page, every episode gets a Duplicate action next to Delete, and the copy shows up in the list without a reload. Both languages.
Add tests.

Work on your own; nobody will answer questions. When you finish, report: status `done` if you did the task, `not_found` if something the task names does not exist, `blocked` if you could not do it; `answer` holds any answer the task asks for (otherwise one short sentence); `changed` lists the files you changed.
follow_ups:
Change of plan for the order: a copy goes right after its original, and the episodes after it move down one place. Deleting an episode closes the gap. A project's episodes are always numbered 1, 2, 3… with no gaps or repeats, and the list API returns them in that order.
Keep the tests up to date.

Users delete episodes by mistake. Add `POST /api/v1/episodes/{id}/restore`: a deleted episode comes back with its cuts at the place it had, and the episodes from there on move down one place. Only members of its workspace may restore it; to anyone else it does not exist (404).
On the Episodes page, the message shown after a delete offers Undo, which restores the episode. Both languages. Add tests.

+def _duplicate_cut_image(
+    session: Session,
+    orig_cut: StoryCut,
+    new_cut_id: UUID,

+    """Copy a cut's stored image and Asset record so episodes stay independent."""

+    new_image_asset_id = None

+        character_reference_board_urls=list(episode.character_reference_board_urls) if episode.character_reference_board_urls else [],
+    )
+    ordered = active_episodes[: orig_index + 1] + [new_episode] + active_episodes[orig_index + 1 :]

+
+    original_cuts = session.exec(

+    ).all()
+
+    for orig_cut in original_cuts:
+        new_cut_id = uuid4()
+        new_image_path, new_image_asset_id = _duplicate_cut_image(
+            session, orig_cut, new_cut_id, user_uuid
+        )
+        new_cut = StoryCut(
+            id=new_cut_id,
+            episode_id=new_episode.id,
+            cut_order=orig_cut.cut_order,
+            script=orig_cut.script,

+            dialogues=copy.deepcopy(orig_cut.dialogues) if orig_cut.dialogues is not None else [],
+            appearing_characters=copy.deepcopy(orig_cut.appearing_characters) if orig_cut.appearing_characters is not None else [],
+            embedding=copy.deepcopy(orig_cut.embedding) if orig_cut.embedding is not None else None,
+            refer_prev_cut=orig_cut.refer_prev_cut,
+        )
+        session.add(new_cut)

+    session.commit()
+    session.refresh(new_episode)
+    return _build_episode_out(session, new_episode)

+        "image_path": kwargs.get("image_path"),

+def test_episode_ordering_after_duplicate_delete_and_create(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    project = _create_project(client, h)
+
+    # Create episodes, including an out-of-range/gapped order and duplicate order
+    e1 = _create_episode(client, h, project["id"], title="Ep A", order=1)
+    e2 = _create_episode(client, h, project["id"], title="Ep B", order=10)  # clamped to 2
+    e3 = _create_episode(client, h, project["id"], title="Ep C", order=3)
+
+    listed = client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes?project_id={project['id']}", headers=h).json()
+    assert [(e["title"], e["episode_order"]) for e in listed] == [
+        ("Ep A", 1),
+        ("Ep B", 2),
+        ("Ep C", 3),
+    ]
+
+    # Duplicate middle episode (Ep B, order 2) -> copy becomes 3, Ep C shifts to 4
+    b_copy = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{e2['id']}/duplicate", headers=h).json()
+    assert b_copy["episode_order"] == 3
+    listed = client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes?project_id={project['id']}", headers=h).json()
+    assert [(e["title"], e["episode_order"]) for e in listed] == [
+        ("Ep A", 1),
+        ("Ep B", 2),
+        ("Ep B (Copy)", 3),
+        ("Ep C", 4),
+    ]
+
+    # Duplicate first episode (Ep A, order 1) -> copy becomes 2, others shift down
+    a_copy = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{e1['id']}/duplicate", headers=h).json()
+    assert a_copy["episode_order"] == 2
+    listed = client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes?project_id={project['id']}", headers=h).json()
+    assert [(e["title"], e["episode_order"]) for e in listed] == [
+        ("Ep A", 1),
+        ("Ep A (Copy)", 2),
+        ("Ep B", 3),
+        ("Ep B (Copy)", 4),
+        ("Ep C", 5),
+    ]
+
+    # Duplicate last episode (Ep C, order 5) -> copy becomes 6
+    c_copy = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{e3['id']}/duplicate", headers=h).json()
+    assert c_copy["episode_order"] == 6
+
+    # Delete middle episode (Ep B, order 3) -> closes gap
+    assert client.delete(f"/api/v1/episodes/{e2['id']}", headers=h).status_code == 204
+    listed = client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes?project_id={project['id']}", headers=h).json()
+    assert [(e["title"], e["episode_order"]) for e in listed] == [
+        ("Ep A", 1),
+        ("Ep A (Copy)", 2),
+        ("Ep B (Copy)", 3),
+        ("Ep C", 4),
+        ("Ep C (Copy)", 5),
+    ]
+
+    # Delete first episode (Ep A, order 1) -> closes gap
+    assert client.delete(f"/api/v1/episodes/{e1['id']}", headers=h).status_code == 204
+    listed = client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes?project_id={project['id']}", headers=h).json()
+    assert [(e["title"], e["episode_order"]) for e in listed] == [
+        ("Ep A (Copy)", 1),
+        ("Ep B (Copy)", 2),
+        ("Ep C", 3),
+        ("Ep C (Copy)", 4),
+    ]
+
+    # Creating with a repeated order (2) inserts without repeat or gap
+    _create_episode(client, h, project["id"], title="Inserted", order=2)
+    listed = client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes?project_id={project['id']}", headers=h).json()
+    assert [(e["title"], e["episode_order"]) for e in listed] == [
+        ("Ep A (Copy)", 1),
+        ("Inserted", 2),
+        ("Ep B (Copy)", 3),
+        ("Ep C", 4),
+        ("Ep C (Copy)", 5),
+    ]
